The '''SuperHaul Model II''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] of the [[SuperHaul]] line manufactured by [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]] that was designed to haul cargo.
